title: Standing feet rest on the ground
notes: With the walk or run preview switched on, your wanderer now stands with both feet on the ground under them when you stop on a slope, instead of one foot sinking in and the other hovering.
Walking off and stopping again ease the feet onto and off the slope instead of jumping them.
This is part of the walk and run previews: launch with WAR_WALK_CYCLE=1 or WAR_RUN_CYCLE=1 to try it. Ordinary launches stand exactly as before.
